review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines sourceWidth, its simp lemmas, the SourceConstituent abbrev, templateOriginalWord, templateWordMask, and two bridging lemmas. All of these are project-specific: they depend on the Template.Role layout, SourceConfiguration, PrimeUpTo and constituentSampleState. I found no Mathlib, Batteries or core concept that they compete with. templateOriginalWord is a named restriction of the constituent function to the word slot. templateWordMask is a named wrapper around the project's own binIndicator. I also saw that the project has a second, unrelated binIndicator in OAI/Probability/EntangledGames/SpectralBins.lean, which has a different signature and a different concept. That is an internal project overlap that does not involve any declaration in the target file, and it is not a Mathlib duplicate. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively, but nothing in this file looks like a competing version of a Mathlib concept.
